newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone up amid investor presentations.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone up amid investor presentations.

text.p: Vodafone Plc shares held their early gains on Wednesday as the company's recently-appointed managing director Chris Gent met U.S. institutions and the stock was boosted by yesterday's strong subscriber numbers.
A Vodafone spokeswoman said Gent was in the U.S. this week meeting a series of fund managers, though further details were not immediately available.
This week's meetings are in addition to a forthcoming telecoms conference in the U.S., hosted by Goldman Sachs, where Vodafone is among companies due to present to U.S. investors and analysts.
Earlier Vodafone stock rose in continued reaction to yesterday's statement that international subscribers had risen to more than one million.
Analysts at Merrill raised their price target on the stock to 300p and SocGen analyst John Tysoe also repeated a "buy" on the stock.
Gent took over as group managing director from Sir Gerry Whent on January 1. He was previously head of the company's UK network.
Vodafone shares were up 13-1/2p at 274-1/2 by 1518 GMT, after earlier reaching a 15-month high of 276p.
